exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix parent-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: parent-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec card apply graph.json

# A parent is reported only after its final non-terminal direct child closes.
exec card close parent-2
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/close-first.txt
exec card close parent-3
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/close-last.txt

# Root issues have no parent outcome.
exec card close parent-4
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/close-root.txt

# Cancelled children count as no longer open.
exec card cancel parent-6
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/cancel-first.txt
exec card cancel parent-7
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/cancel-last.txt

# Both checkpoint terminal paths report their containment parent.
exec card checkpoint approve parent-9
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/pass.txt
exec card checkpoint deny parent-11
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/fail.txt

# Structured output remains one value and names the additional parent outcome.
exec card --json close parent-13
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/closed.json
exec card --json cancel parent-15
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/cancelled.json
exec card --json checkpoint approve parent-17
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/passed.json
exec card --json checkpoint deny parent-19
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/failed.json
